pages.notes: Digital government document with strikethrough redactions causing significant OCR corruption in narrative section (e.g., 'Tiliii)TO OH'), but structured metadata and Admin sections captured reasonably well; 1.4a redaction boxes recognized throughout.

Military personnel/tasking form with extensive FOIA redactions. OCR captured most structured fields correctly but failed on some plain text ('Poc' → 'Poe', 'AIC' → 'AlC') and garbled redacted field overlays and strikethrough text.

Military incident form with equipment specification fields; OCR successfully captured most structured data but garbled the red "SECRET/NOFORN" classification stamps at top and bottom, rendering them as corrupted characters.

Declassified military form with structured mission timeline data; OCR captured most content accurately but generated garbage text artifact (fteMTff!fM8Ni) in header area, likely from security markings.

Declassified military ISR asset utilization form with redaction boxes. OCR captured most content but struggled at redaction boundaries, causing missing/corrupted characters (e.g., 'T~236' instead of 'TH[1.4a]236', '~ONDUCTED' instead of 'CONDUCTED').

Declassified government form with multiple redacted sections (1.4a). OCR captured main content and structure well, but garbled header/footer formatting (SECRET/NOFORN rendered as '!f:!emffl'11N'M6lt!f') and struggled with special characters like the (S/NF) classification marking.
